Explore ways to play ↗

GOOD GAMES START WITH GOOD QUESTIONS.

Plan your visit before you step onto the court.

Can I come without a partner?

+

Yes, you can ask the club about a suitable way to join. Share your experience and preferred format so the team can discuss the options with you.

What equipment should I bring?

+

Wear comfortable sports clothing and suitable footwear. Check with the club about rackets, balls, and any requirements for your session.

How is my session confirmed?

+

Contact the team with your preferred session and date. The club confirms the available arrangements directly before you visit.
